_about: D&D locations and minis (docs/DND-3D-GOAL.md). A location's map is an ASCII layout, one string per row: '.' floor, '#' wall, 'D' door (walkable), '~' difficult terrain (walkable, costs double), 'P' a player spawn, 'M' a monster spawn (both floor). The same layout builds the Blender room. Files (art, shot, room) live in R2 under dnd/locations/<id>/; a location without them still plays on the grid. status: 'draft' until a person has reviewed its art and room in /dnd/review.
